561	def _write_name(out, labels, offsets):
562	    """把域名写入 out；offsets 记录已出现的标签边界（后缀 -> 最小偏移）。"""
563	    match = 0
564	    target = None
565	    for i in range(len(labels)):
566	        suffix = tuple(labels[i:])
567	        if suffix in offsets:
568	            match = len(labels) - i
569	            target = offsets[suffix]
570	            break
571	    stop = len(labels) - match
572	    for i, label in enumerate(labels):
573	        if i >= stop:
574	            break
575	        if len(out) <= _MAX_POINTER_TARGET:
576	            offsets.setdefault(tuple(labels[i:]), len(out))
577	        out.append(len(label))
578	        out.extend(label.encode("ascii"))
579	    if target is not None:
580	        out.extend((0xC000 | target).to_bytes(2, "big"))
581	    else:
582	        out.append(0)

585	def _build_message(msg, an, ns, ar, rcode):
586	    """一次性编码完整报文，返回 (out, body_base, 各区段 RR 结束偏移, flags)。
587	
588	    尾删只保留报文前缀：压缩指针只指向更早写入的名字，保留的前缀
589	    自身即合法报文，故按结束偏移切片即可，无需反复重新编码。
590	    """
591	    flags = _FLAGS_RESPONSE | (msg["flags"] & _FLAGS_KEPT) | rcode
592	    out = bytearray()
593	    out += msg["id"].to_bytes(2, "big")
594	    out += flags.to_bytes(2, "big")
595	    out += len(msg["questions"]).to_bytes(2, "big")
596	    out += len(an).to_bytes(2, "big")
597	    out += len(ns).to_bytes(2, "big")
598	    out += len(ar).to_bytes(2, "big")
599	    offsets = {}
600	    for question in msg["questions"]:
601	        _write_name(out, _normalize_name(question["name"]), offsets)
602	        out += question["type"].to_bytes(2, "big")
603	        out += question["class"].to_bytes(2, "big")
604	    body_base = len(out)
605	    section_ends = []
606	    for section in (an, ns, ar):
607	        ends = []
608	        for labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata in section:
609	            _write_name(out, labels, offsets)
610	            out += rrtype.to_bytes(2, "big")
611	            out += rrclass.to_bytes(2, "big")
612	            out += ttl.to_bytes(4, "big")
613	            out += len(rdata).to_bytes(2, "big")
614	            out += rdata
615	            ends.append(len(out))
616	        section_ends.append(ends)
617	    return out, body_base, section_ends, flags

620	def _encode_response(query, model, rcode):
621	    """把查询报文与应答模型编码为确定性权威应答报文（rcode 由内部指定）。"""
622	    if not isinstance(query, bytes):
623	        raise TypeError("query must be bytes")
624	    _check_int(rcode, "rcode")
625	    if not 0 <= rcode <= 0xF:
626	        raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
627	    an, ns, ar, limit = _validate_model(model)
628	    msg = decode_query(query)
629	    if msg["flags"] & 0x8000:
630	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
631	    if not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT:
632	        raise EncodeError("limit out of range")
633	    truncated = False
634	    # 区段计数为 16 位：超过 65535 条时按 ar、ns、an 尾删整条并置 TC，
635	    # 不得让计数溢出。
636	    for section in (ar, ns, an):
637	        if len(section) > _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:
638	            del section[_MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:]
639	            truncated = True
640	    out, body_base, (an_ends, ns_ends, ar_ends), flags = _build_message(
641	        msg, an, ns, ar, rcode)
642	    na, nn, nr = len(an), len(ns), len(ar)
643	    total_end = ar_ends[-1] if ar_ends else (
644	        ns_ends[-1] if ns_ends else (an_ends[-1] if an_ends else body_base))
645	    if total_end > limit:
646	        # 超长：先尾删 ar，ar 清空仍超长再尾删 ns，最后尾删 an。
647	        truncated = True
648	        nr = bisect_right(ar_ends, limit)
649	        if nr == 0:
650	            nn = bisect_right(ns_ends, limit)
651	            if nn == 0:
652	                na = bisect_right(an_ends, limit)
653	                if na == 0 and body_base > limit:
654	                    raise EncodeError("header and question exceed limit")
655	    if nr:
656	        end = ar_ends[nr - 1]
657	    elif nn:
658	        end = ns_ends[nn - 1]
659	    elif na:
660	        end = an_ends[na - 1]
661	    else:
662	        end = body_base
663	    result = bytearray(out[:end])
664	    result[6:8] = na.to_bytes(2, "big")
665	    result[8:10] = nn.to_bytes(2, "big")
666	    result[10:12] = nr.to_bytes(2, "big")
667	    if truncated:
668	        result[2:4] = (flags | _FLAG_TC).to_bytes(2, "big")
669	    return bytes(result)
670

677	def edns(query: bytes, model: dict, rcode: int = 0) -> bytes:
678	    """把（可含 OPT 的）查询报文与应答模型编码为 EDNS 应答报文。
679	
680	    query/model 的解码与编码契约同 decode_query/encode_response；查询
681	    AR 限 0 或 1 条，有则须为未压缩根 owner、TYPE41、CLASS512..65535、
682	    扩展码/版本 0、flags 仅 DO、RDLENGTH0 的 OPT。非法 AR/OPT、截断、
683	    尾随或 model 含 OPT 抛 EDNSError。rcode 须非 bool 整数（类型错
684	    TypeError）：有 OPT 限 0..4095、无 OPT 限 0..15，越界 EncodeError。
685	    无 OPT 时上限 min(model.limit, 512) 且不回 OPT；有 OPT 时上限
686	    min(model.limit, CLASS)，应答 ar 末项为同 CLASS 根 OPT，
687	    TTL=(rcode>>4)<<24|DO，头部低 4 位为 rcode&15。编码其余同
688	    encode_response：超限按 ar、ns、an 尾删并置 TC，OPT 不删；
689	    问题与 OPT 超限抛 EncodeError。
690	    """
691	    if not isinstance(query, bytes):
692	        raise TypeError("query must be bytes")
693	    _check_int(rcode, "rcode")
694	    an, ns, ar, limit = _validate_model(model)
695	    msg, opt = _decode_edns_query(query)
696	    for section in (an, ns, ar):
697	        if any(rr[1] == _TYPE_OPT for rr in section):
698	            raise EDNSError("model must not contain OPT records")
699	    if msg["flags"] & 0x8000:
700	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
701	    if not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT:
702	        raise EncodeError("limit out of range")
703	    opt_wire = b""
704	    if opt is None:
705	        if not 0 <= rcode <= 0xF:
706	            raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
707	        limit = min(limit, _MAX_MESSAGE_LEN)
708	    else:
709	        if not 0 <= rcode <= _MAX_EDNS_RCODE:
710	            raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
711	        opt_class, do = opt
712	        limit = min(limit, opt_class)
713	        ttl = ((rcode >> 4) << 24) | (_FLAG_DO if do else 0)
714	        opt_wire = (b"\x00" + _TYPE_OPT.to_bytes(2, "big")
715	                    + opt_class.to_bytes(2, "big") + ttl.to_bytes(4, "big")
716	                    + b"\x00\x00")
717	    truncated = False
718	    # 区段计数为 16 位：OPT 占 ar 一席且不删，model 的 ar 预算相应减一。
719	    max_ar = _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS - (1 if opt_wire else 0)
720	    if len(ar) > max_ar:
721	        del ar[max_ar:]
722	        truncated = True
723	    for section in (ns, an):
724	        if len(section) > _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:
725	            del section[_MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:]
726	            truncated = True
727	    out, body_base, (an_ends, ns_ends, ar_ends), flags = _build_message(
728	        msg, an, ns, ar, rcode & 0xF)
729	    body_limit = limit - len(opt_wire)  # 为 OPT 预留，OPT 不参与尾删
730	    na, nn, nr = len(an), len(ns), len(ar)
731	    total_end = ar_ends[-1] if ar_ends else (
732	        ns_ends[-1] if ns_ends else (an_ends[-1] if an_ends else body_base))
733	    if total_end > body_limit:
734	        # 超长：先尾删 ar，ar 清空仍超长再尾删 ns，最后尾删 an。
735	        truncated = True
736	        nr = bisect_right(ar_ends, body_limit)
737	        if nr == 0:
738	            nn = bisect_right(ns_ends, body_limit)
739	            if nn == 0:
740	                na = bisect_right(an_ends, body_limit)
741	                if na == 0 and body_base > body_limit:
742	                    raise EncodeError("header and question exceed limit")
743	    if nr:
744	        end = ar_ends[nr - 1]
745	    elif nn:
746	        end = ns_ends[nn - 1]
747	    elif na:
748	        end = an_ends[na - 1]
749	    else:
750	        end = body_base
751	    result = bytearray(out[:end])
752	    result += opt_wire
753	    result[6:8] = na.to_bytes(2, "big")
754	    result[8:10] = nn.to_bytes(2, "big")
755	    result[10:12] = (nr + (1 if opt_wire else 0)).to_bytes(2, "big")
756	    if truncated:
757	        result[2:4] = (flags | _FLAG_TC).to_bytes(2, "big")
758	    return bytes(result)

773	def _hop(records, nodes, origin, current, qtype):
774	    """单跳查找 current 的 qtype 记录，返回 (kind, rrs)。
775	
776	    kind 为 "answer"（rrs 为命中记录，通配 owner 已合成为 current）、
777	    "cname"（rrs 为合成后的单条 CNAME，仅 qtype≠5 时出现）、
778	    "nodata"（节点或通配存在但无该类型）或 "nxdomain"。
779	    """
780	    if tuple(current) in nodes:
781	        # 同名节点存在（含空非终端）：不回退通配。
782	        if qtype != _TYPE_CNAME:
783	            for rr in records:
784	                if rr[0] == current and rr[1] == _TYPE_CNAME:
785	                    return "cname", rr
786	        matched = [rr for rr in records
787	                   if rr[0] == current and rr[1] == qtype]
788	        if matched:
789	            return "answer", matched[:1] if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME else matched
790	        return "nodata", None
791	    # 节点不存在：取最长既存后缀，只检查 "*."+该后缀。
792	    encloser = None
793	    for i in range(1, len(current) - len(origin) + 1):
794	        if tuple(current[i:]) in nodes:
795	            encloser = current[i:]
796	            break
797	    wildcard = ["*"] + encloser
798	    if qtype != _TYPE_CNAME:
799	        for rr in records:
800	            if rr[0] == wildcard and rr[1] == _TYPE_CNAME:
801	                return "cname", (list(current), rr[1], rr[2], rr[3], rr[4])
802	    matched = [rr for rr in records
803	               if rr[0] == wildcard and rr[1] == qtype]
804	    if matched:
805	        if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME:
806	            matched = matched[:1]
807	        return "answer", [(list(current), rr[1], rr[2], rr[3], rr[4])
808	                          for rr in matched]
809	    if any(rr[0] == wildcard for rr in records):
810	        return "nodata", None
811	    return "nxdomain", None

814	def _resolve_chain(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype):
815	    """在 origin 内解析（qtype≠5 时跟随 CNAME 链），返回 (rcode, an, ns)。"""
816	    soa = [rr for rr in records if rr[0] == origin and rr[1] == _TYPE_SOA]
817	    if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME:
818	        kind, rrs = _hop(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype)
819	        if kind == "answer":
820	            return 0, rrs, []
821	        if kind == "nodata":
822	            return 0, [], soa
823	        return _RCODE_NXDOMAIN, [], soa
824	    an = []
825	    seen = {tuple(qlabels)}
826	    current = list(qlabels)
827	    while True:
828	        kind, rrs = _hop(records, nodes, origin, current, qtype)
829	        if kind == "answer":
830	            return 0, an + rrs, []
831	        if kind == "nodata":
832	            return 0, an, soa
833	        if kind == "nxdomain":
834	            return _RCODE_NXDOMAIN, an, soa
835	        # 命中 CNAME：先入链，再查目标；第 17 条或名称重复即失败。
836	        if len(an) >= _MAX_CNAME_CHAIN:
837	            raise CNAMEError("cname chain too long")
838	        an.append(rrs)
839	        target = _decode_cname_target(rrs[4])
840	        if tuple(target) in seen:
841	            raise CNAMEError("cname chain loop")
842	        seen.add(tuple(target))
843	        if (len(target) < len(origin)
844	                or target[len(target) - len(origin):] != origin):
845	            return 0, an, []  # 目标在 origin 外：返回积累链，ns 为空
846	        current = target

852	    msg 为已解码且通过可应答性检查的单问题查询；zone 已校验，

864	        rcode = _RCODE_NXDOMAIN  # 查询名在 origin 之外
865	        ns = [rr for rr in records

871	            for i in range(len(labels) - len(origin)):
872	                nodes.add(tuple(labels[i:]))
873	        rcode, an, ns = _resolve_chain(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype)
874	    return rcode, an, ns

998	class PositiveCache:
999	    """容量 256 的正/负答案缓存（FIFO 淘汰，命中不重排）。
1000	
1001	    正缓存键为 (小写绝对 qname, qtype, qclass)，与 ID、flags、limit 无关。
1002	    仅缓存 RCODE=0、ns 空、an 非空且各原始 TTL 均为正的完整有序应答；
1003	    条目保存插入时刻与原始 RR，输出 TTL 随经过时间递减，到期即删除。
1004	
1005	    负缓存仅收完整计划所得且 an 为空的 NXDOMAIN（RCODE=3，键为小写绝对
1006	    (qname, qclass)，匹配任意 qtype）与 NODATA（RCODE=0，键为
1007	    (qname, qtype, qclass)），且 ns 恰为 origin 唯一 SOA；SOA rdata 须
1008	    完整为两个未压缩绝对域名及五个网络序 uint32，负 TTL 为
1009	    min(SOA ttl, 第五个 uint32)，格式错或负 TTL 为 0 则不缓存。
1010	    负命中时 RCODE 不变，an/ar 为空，ns 仅该 SOA 且 ttl 随经过时间递减。
1011	
1012	    查找顺序为正缓存、NODATA、NXDOMAIN；正负条目共用容量与同一 FIFO。
1013	    任何失败（含编码失败）都不改变条目与时钟状态。
1014	    """
1015	
1016	    def __init__(self, zone: dict):
1017	        # 深拷贝后按 answer 规则校验：外部对 zone 的后续改动与缓存隔离，
1018	        # 校验异常与 answer 完全一致。
1019	        zone = copy.deepcopy(zone)
1020	        self._origin, self._records, self._zone_class = _validate_zone(zone)
1021	        self._entries = {}  # 正缓存键 -> (插入时刻, 规范化 an)
1022	        self._neg_entries = {}  # 负缓存键 -> (插入时刻, rcode, 规范化 SOA, 负 TTL)
1023	        self._order = deque()  # (类别, 键) 插入次序；与两个字典的键集合始终一致
1024	        self._last_now = None  # 上次成功 resolve 的时钟值
1025	
1026	    def _negative_entry(self, key, rcode, an, ns, now):
1027	        """完整计划可负缓存时返回 (负缓存键, 条目)，否则返回 None。"""
1028	        if an or rcode not in (0, _RCODE_NXDOMAIN):
1029	            return None
1030	        if (len(ns) != 1 or ns[0][0] != self._origin
1031	                or ns[0][1] != _TYPE_SOA):
1032	            return None
1033	        soa = ns[0]
1034	        minimum = _parse_soa_minimum(soa[4])
1035	        if minimum is None:
1036	            return None
1037	        neg_ttl = min(soa[3], minimum)
1038	        if neg_ttl == 0:
1039	            return None
1040	        if rcode == _RCODE_NXDOMAIN:
1041	            neg_key = ("nxdomain", key[0], key[2])  # 匹配任意 qtype
1042	        else:
1043	            neg_key = ("nodata",) + key
1044	        return neg_key, (now, rcode, soa, neg_ttl)
1045	
1046	    def resolve(self, query: bytes, now: int,
1047	                limit: int = 512) -> tuple[bytes, bool]:
1048	        if not isinstance(now, int) or isinstance(now, bool):
1049	            raise TypeError("now must be int")
1050	        if now < 0 or (self._last_now is not None and now < self._last_now):
1051	            raise CacheError("now must be non-negative and monotonic")
1052	        # query、limit 的异常沿用 answer。
1053	        msg = decode_query(query)
1054	        _check_int(limit, "limit")
1055	        if (msg["flags"] & 0x8000 or len(msg["questions"]) != 1
1056	                or not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT):
1057	            raise EncodeError("query or limit not answerable")
1058	        question = msg["questions"][0]
1059	        key = (question["name"], question["type"], question["class"])
1060	        expired = None  # 到期条目在 _order 中的标记键，待编码成功后清理
1061	        entry = self._entries.get(key)
1062	        if entry is not None:
1063	            inserted, an = entry
1064	            elapsed = now - inserted
1065	            min_ttl = min(rr[3] for rr in an)
1066	            if elapsed < min_ttl:
1067	                aged = [(labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl - elapsed, rdata)
1068	                        for labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata in an]
1069	                # 用本次 ID、flags、问题段、limit 重编码；截断不改条目，
1070	                # 命中也不改变插入次序。
1071	                response = _encode_plan(query, 0, aged, [], limit)
1072	                self._last_now = now
1073	                return response, True
1074	            # 到期：先记下，待新应答编码成功后再清理，保证失败不改状态。
1075	            expired = ("pos", key)
1076	        else:
1077	            # 正缓存未中：NODATA 先于 NXDOMAIN 查找。
1078	            neg_key = ("nodata",) + key
1079	            neg = self._neg_entries.get(neg_key)
1080	            if neg is None:
1081	                neg_key = ("nxdomain", key[0], key[2])
1082	                neg = self._neg_entries.get(neg_key)
1083	            if neg is not None:
1084	                inserted, rcode, soa, neg_ttl = neg
1085	                elapsed = now - inserted
1086	                if elapsed < neg_ttl:
1087	                    aged_soa = (soa[0], soa[1], soa[2],
1088	                                neg_ttl - elapsed, soa[4])
1089	                    # 用本次 ID、flags、问题段、limit 重编码；RCODE 不变，
1090	                    # an/ar 为空，ns 仅 SOA；截断不改条目与插入次序。
1091	                    response = _encode_plan(query, rcode, [], [aged_soa], limit)
1092	                    self._last_now = now
1093	                    return response, True
1094	                expired = ("neg", neg_key)
1095	        # 未命中（含到期）：先按 answer 语义生成未截断的完整有序应答。
1096	        rcode, an, ns = _answer_plan(
1097	            msg, self._origin, self._records, self._zone_class)
1098	        # 先编码成功再落条目，保证编码失败不改变任何状态。
1099	        response = _encode_plan(query, rcode, an, ns, limit)
1100	        if expired is not None:
1101	            tag, ekey = expired
1102	            del (self._entries if tag == "pos" else self._neg_entries)[ekey]
1103	            self._order.remove(expired)  # 到期删除后按未命中刷新
1104	        if rcode == 0 and not ns and an and all(rr[3] > 0 for rr in an):
1105	            self._entries[key] = (now, an)
1106	            self._order.append(("pos", key))
1107	        else:
1108	            negative = self._negative_entry(key, rcode, an, ns, now)
1109	            if negative is not None:
1110	                neg_key, neg_entry = negative
1111	                self._neg_entries[neg_key] = neg_entry
1112	                self._order.append(("neg", neg_key))
1113	        if len(self._order) > _CACHE_CAPACITY:
1114	            tag, oldest = self._order.popleft()  # 满时淘汰最早插入者
1115	            del (self._entries if tag == "pos" else self._neg_entries)[oldest]
1116	        self._last_now = now
1117	        return response, False

1160	def _reply_question_end(reply, qdcount):
1161	    """按 qdcount 从偏移 12 起界定问题段结束位置；无法界定返回 None。"""
1162	    pos = _MIN_MESSAGE_LEN
1163	    for _ in range(qdcount):
1164	        while True:
1165	            if pos >= len(reply):
1166	                return None
1167	            length = reply[pos]
1168	            kind = length & 0xC0
1169	            if kind == 0xC0:
1170	                if pos + 1 >= len(reply):
1171	                    return None
1172	                pos += 2
1173	                break
1174	            if kind != 0x00:
1175	                return None
1176	            pos += 1
1177	            if length == 0:
1178	                break
1179	            if pos + length > len(reply):
1180	                return None
1181	            pos += length
1182	        if pos + 4 > len(reply):
1183	            return None
1184	        pos += 4
1185	    return pos

1203	def forward(query, plan, now, timeout=5):
1204	    """按 plan 顺序模拟向上游转发 query。
1205	
1206	    每项上游仅取前 2 个事件；时钟自 now 累计：delay > timeout 记超时并
1207	    推进 timeout，否则推进 delay 后检查应答（None 或不合格记失败）。
1208	    成功返回 (reply, name, 结束时刻)；全部超时抛 UpstreamTimeout，
1209	    其余耗尽情形（含无事件）抛 UpstreamError。
1210	    """
1211	    msg = decode_query(query)  # TypeError/MessageError 原样传播
1212	    if msg["flags"] & _FLAG_QR:
1213	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
1214	    _check_non_negative_int(now, "now")
1215	    _check_int(timeout, "timeout")
1216	    if not _MIN_TIMEOUT <= timeout <= _MAX_TIMEOUT:
1217	        raise ValueError("timeout out of range")
1218	    items = _validate_plan(plan)
1219	    clock = now
1220	    saw_timeout = False
1221	    saw_other = False
1222	    for name, events in items:
1223	        for delay, reply in events[:_PLAN_EVENTS_USED]:
1224	            if delay > timeout:
1225	                saw_timeout = True
1226	                clock += timeout
1227	                continue
1228	            clock += delay
1229	            if reply is not None and _matching_reply(query, reply):
1230	                return reply, name, clock
1231	            saw_other = True
1232	    if saw_timeout and not saw_other:
1233	        raise UpstreamTimeout("all upstream attempts timed out")
1234	    raise UpstreamError("no usable upstream reply")

1363	def _ratio_six(p, q):

1370	    elif 2 * remainder == q and quotient % 2 == 1:
1371	        quotient += 1

1498	    def _recursive_cache_lookup(self, query, question, now, limit):

1508	            inserted, an = entry

1510	            if elapsed < min(rr[3] for rr in an):

1512	                        for labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata in an]
1513	                return _encode_plan(query, 0, aged, [], limit), None, "pos"
1514	            return None, ("pos", key), None
1515	        neg_key = ("nodata",) + key
1516	        neg = self._rec_neg.get(neg_key)
